issues.title: Uganda crop_production: country fallback violates requested wave coverage
issues.body:
Uganda's normal crop-production country fallback does not respect requested wave coverage. This is a pre-existing residual observed while verifying #1198 / PR #1202; that PR adds no Makefile, country builder or framework routing change.

At actual parent `989fbf3d98439be802d1f9cebd8ab5197c56b002` (library/tests equal release `f8d236694c26fe9e709c5548f02c70f74ea72c33`) and candidate runtime `929149222e43a8fe500cc08420cdc68357170af3` / frozen source `6e735eca93e3f68e63d79ce65ac71607ee9493bf`:

- With `LSMS_BUILD_BACKEND=make`, `Country('Uganda').crop_production(waves=['2005-06'])` returns all seven OTHER supported waves: 133,331 parent / 133,761 candidate rows. The requested wave declares no crop-production table.
- The supported singleton `waves=['2018-19']` also returns the whole country. The matching default API returns only 15,616 / 15,630 rows.
- Default unsupported public output is correctly empty, but its cold country fallback leaves all 133,331 / 133,761 raw rows stamped with the requested-only `['2005-06']` coverage manifest. Those rows do not belong to 2005-06.
- Make writes a hashless country parquet without coverage metadata. Populated fresh-process requests repeat the wrong-wave outputs; eight crop endpoints receive mtime-only writes, with bytes/sizes/modes exact. Default populated calls write nothing.

The author's eight subset cohorts preserve complete raw/public frames, typed attrs, footers and per-wave counts. Independent review references that immutable subset evidence; it did not repeat those subset calls. Independent normal all-wave results separately preserve the source observations. No production fix is included here.

Next work (tier A/B): trace the country builder's ID-walk/audit transport and every fallback caller, then make supported and barren subsets obey the existing framework-authoritative request/coverage contract. Preserve maximal observation grain, full attrs, IDs, source eligibility, quantities and existing factor screens. Verify ordinary cold, populated and fresh-process calls under both backends, including raw cache coverage. Do not hide this with a final post-hoc subset filter, cache bypass or fabricated coverage.

Deduplication: #1091 is specifically the Mali/Niger/Tanzania community-price retirement; #788 supplies the settled authority ruling. Closed #1099 fixes the default barren-subset public-result behavior, not this country-builder Make route/raw coverage. #1146 is test-side baseline coverage, and #1198 is the distinct source-record contract. No matching open Uganda wave-subset issue was found.

[Independent residual account](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/RESIDUALS.md) · [Review and evidence lineage](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/REVIEW.org) · [Reproduction stages](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/REPRODUCE.sh)

Sue

issues.title: Uganda yield_kg: diagnose incomplete parcel-area matches and correct the 100% coverage claim
issues.body:
The current `yield_kg` documentation says Uganda's parcel key matches on “100% of crop rows” (`transformations.py:4934` in the reviewed source). Normally rebuilt held-source Uganda area/harvest tables contradict that blanket statement on both actual heads used for #1198 / PR #1202.

Measured at actual parent `989fbf3d98439be802d1f9cebd8ab5197c56b002` (library/tests equal release f8) and candidate runtime `929149222e43a8fe500cc08420cdc68357170af3` / frozen source `6e735eca93e3f68e63d79ce65ac71607ee9493bf`:

- Area table: 42,841 rows; 37,636 positive-area rows and 37,634 positive parcel keys.
- Converted harvest: 40,409 parcel keys; only 14,022 match positive-area keys under the actual parcel route.
- Literal plot routing matches zero.
- The complete 14,022 parcel-yield output frames, including typed attrs, are exactly unchanged by #1198. This is an existing coverage limitation, not a native-observation regression.

Uganda CONTENTS already documents different crop/plot-feature key vocabularies and requires `on='parcel'`. These counts do not distinguish unmeasured area from household/parcel linkage mismatch, and do not justify prefix guessing, area imputation, a new join grain or modifying the measured yield frames.

Next work (diagnose first, tier B for linkage; documentation correction follows the source diagnosis): bind each release's actual household/parcel/plot construction and area eligibility; partition unmatched harvest keys into explained cases; replace the blanket coverage statement with the supported result. Any eventual key repair needs independent source authority and complete frame/attrs tests.

Deduplication: closed #879 concerns canonical area UNITS in six other countries and explicitly records Uganda's hectare conversion; it does not own this linkage/coverage question. #1146 is test-side cache coverage. #1150 concerns other countries' geovariables. No matching Uganda area/parcel-coverage issue was found. Factor wiring #849 and observation identity #1198 remain separate.

[Independent review](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/REVIEW.org) · [Residual account](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/RESIDUALS.md) · [Reproduction stages](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/REPRODUCE.sh)

issues.title: Cold/warm index StringDtype drift: Niger food_acquired and Uganda cluster_features
issues.body:
Additional independently measured manifestation (2026-10-22): Uganda `cluster_features` has the same cold/warm **dtype symptom**, on a plain `pandas.Index` named `v`, rather than Niger's `food_acquired` MultiIndex `u` level. This groups two observed cases for diagnosis; a shared root cause is not established.

At actual parent `989fbf3d98439be802d1f9cebd8ab5197c56b002` (library/tests equal release f8) and #1198 candidate `6e735eca93e3f68e63d79ce65ac71607ee9493bf`, both ordinary default and Make cold/warm paths return 4,805 Uganda cluster rows with zero null `v` values. Cold `v` uses pyarrow `StringDtype(na_value=pd.NA)` (`string`); warm uses `StringDtype(na_value=nan)` (`str`). The strict stage comparison fails on dtype; values, codes, masks and recursively typed full attrs otherwise match. Same-stage parent/candidate frames match exactly. No dtype normalization was applied. Match-stage API/CLI serialization distinctions remain separate. [Full dtype account](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/support-dtype.json) and [independent review](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/1f3c5d37475e1bba08c75d5ab45b9a58cabd4a69/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/1198-Uganda-independent/REVIEW.org).

Next diagnosis must discriminate both manifestations and retain strict ordinary cold/fresh-process warm controls for each. Do not assume that fixing one proves the other, broaden this to every string index, or alter country labels/IDs/missingness.

Original Niger diagnosis and reproduction retained:

Ordinary cold and fresh-process warm `Country('Niger').food_acquired()` calls return different `u` index dtypes on both release baseline `f8d236694c26fe9e709c5548f02c70f74ea72c33` and the independently reviewed GH1078 runtime `a4c92ccf6a40a8bf75cbb6c0bf2933cd1e69ec7b`. This is a separate, pre-existing residual; the producer-provenance repair does not fix it.

Both outputs have 239,877 rows. The cold `u` level uses Arrow-backed `StringDtype(na_value=pd.NA)`; the fresh warm level uses Arrow-backed `StringDtype(na_value=nan)`. Their displays are `string` and `str`. An explicit exact full-frame comparison fails on that index dtype under both sources.

The independent artifact-only check proves that every payload value/dtype, mask, key, multiplicity, row order, other index-level dtype/code and recursively typed full attr otherwise matches. It retains both strict dtype failures; the qualified comparison does not rewrite either frame. Warm reads leave the current-hash, full-four-wave cache bytes/modes/mtimes unchanged.

Reproduce in the same checkout and data root, with required raw sources available, initially empty L2, and ordinary cache policy. Save the first public frame, then use a separate process and new Country object:

```python
# Process 1
import lsms_library as ll
ll.Country('Niger').food_acquired().to_pickle('cold-private.pkl')

# Process 2
import pandas as pd
import lsms_library as ll
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
    pd.read_pickle('cold-private.pkl'),
    ll.Country('Niger').food_acquired(),
    check_exact=True, rtol=0, atol=0,
)
```

Measured environment: Python 3.11.6, pandas 3.0.6, pyarrow 25.0.1, numpy 2.4.6. Source/data identity, physically private held-source staging and ordinary cold/warm routes are recorded in the [source diagnosis](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/80679167ba1d286f2abfcfad67aa0e465b3892c2/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/framework1078/DRAFT-RESIDUAL-warm-index-dtype.md), [explicit exact proof](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/80679167ba1d286f2abfcfad67aa0e465b3892c2/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/review-1078-addendum/exact-artifact-proof.json) and [review addendum](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/80679167ba1d286f2abfcfad67aa0e465b3892c2/slurm_logs/isa_backlog_2026-10-21/review-1078-addendum/ADDENDUM.org).

Next work: locate the precise round-trip/read/finalization step and add a discriminating minimal regression plus normal Niger cold/warm verification. Preserve reported labels, missingness, complete frames and attrs; do not suppress the failure with blanket dtype normalization or relaxed tests. Record the country caveat in CONTENTS when the cause and policy are established. No implementation is included here.

Deduplication checked the existing StringDtype/na_value/Niger cold-cache issues, including closed #445; none owns this exact residual.

Sue
